status: Extension on accessed SIPP; analysis plan, not preregistration or external confirmation

bootstrap: Preston one-stage rescaled SRSWOR subset; floor(n/2) within sampled stratum; lambda=sqrt[k(1-f)/(n-k)]
phase1.bounds: Prior-only binary household bounds from 235; theorem4.3 delta=alpha/(10*strata); kappa=7/3+3/sqrt(2); union over signs/strata; census contribution zero
phase1.limits: Bootstrap is approximate, not distribution-free. Household clusters are second-phase experiment units, not recovered original Census PSUs. Full-model refitting not needed because all predictors/allocations are frozen.

phase2.target: Known prior BA gap of ALL baseline adults, scorer reference; not missing later education
phase2.X: Only baseline age, sex, nativity, citizenship, household size, mean age, shares female/foreign/older and log prior weight. NO prior education/allocation flag or follow-up education/weights.
phase2.crossfit: 3 folds by entire historical household; seeds739..743; fitting variation, not independent populations
phase2.response: Household logistic response fit, standard scaled features L2 C=1, max_iter1000
phase2.outcome: HGB fixed 200 iterations, lr .05, 7 leaves, min_leaf20, l2=1, early_stopping=False, seed739
phase2.metrics: Known target error, weight diagnostics, fold variability; NO confidence interval or missing-at-random validation claim
phase2.gate: Run after phase1. No masked label enters a fitted predictor. Masked prior-outcome target differs from actual future-outcome task.

interpretation: Mature controls may solve the problem; do not select by one favorable metric; no new ML claim, no cost or causal claim
